newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takefuji sets secondary share offer price Y7,215.
newsitem.headline: Takefuji sets secondary share offer price Y7,215.

text.p: Takefuji Corp said on Tuesday that the price of each offered share in its 3.3 million share secondary tranche will be 7,215 yen.

The personal loan firm said that the price was based on the share's Tuesday trading level of 7,400 yen with a discount of 2.5 percent. The offer comprises an international tranche of 2.3 million shares and a domestic tranche of 1.0 million.
The subscription period is March 19 to March 21 and delivery is March 25, Takefuji said in a statement.
